operator.name: Kairon
operator.principle: Bio-inspired mechanisms are operational control algorithms. They never imply consciousness and never override constitutional policy.

runtime_proof.truth_rule: Configuration never proves execution. Production scheduler readiness requires immutable healthy tick_completed samples for the same deployed commit.

bioecology.source_inspiration: Conway Replicatio evolutionary ecology mechanics, generalized for Creixement

slime_mold_routing.purpose: allocate attention through nutrient gradients while penalising friction and risk

pheromone_foraging.purpose: reinforce verified productive routes and evaporate stale routes

asexual_budding.purpose: low-cost experimental variant creation from one parent

epigenetics.purpose: temporary phenotype adaptation to environment without altering protected genome

telomeres.purpose: limit stale exploration and encode senescence

red_queen.purpose: increase adaptation pressure under competition, volatility, failure or novelty deficit

niche_speciation.purpose: preserve useful strategic diversity and prevent destructive monoculture

homeostasis.purpose: keep energy, stress and resource consumption inside operating envelopes

hormesis.purpose: use modest verified stress to promote adaptation; suppress risk at extremes

immune_memory.purpose: remember recurrent failure signatures and challenge/block them

apoptosis_archive.purpose: archive persistently weak or senescent variants

hibernation.purpose: pause low-value variants during scarcity and wake them when conditions improve

migration.purpose: move bounded attention toward better verified opportunity gradients

symbiosis.purpose: pair complementary agents/products/strategies when joint fitness is higher

competition.purpose: apply within-niche selection pressure based on verified fitness

predator_detection.purpose: treat dangerous anomalies as immune challenges, not as unverified automatic accusations

wound_healing.purpose: prioritise runtime recovery after dead letters, circuit opens, drift or stale heartbeat

metabolism.purpose: allocate scarce resources maintenance first, execution second, exploration last
